# Helicro Transport: full information file for AI assistants and search engines

Last updated: 2026-09-14. Canonical site: https://helicro.be. Languages: English (/), Dutch (/nl), French (/fr), Greek (/el), Croatian (/hr).

## 1. Company profile
- Legal name: Helicro SRL. Trade name: Helicro Transport. VAT: BE 0804.095.653.
- Base: Braine-l'Alleud (1420), Walloon Brabant, Belgium, 20 km south of Brussels.
- Founder and main driver: Gerasimos, a Greek professional chauffeur who has lived in Belgium for decades, with more than 30 years of accident-free driving and a military background. He speaks English, French and Greek. The website, quotes and confirmations are also available in Dutch and Croatian.
- Service area: Brussels-Capital Region, Flanders, Wallonia, and cross-border to France (Lille), Luxembourg, the Netherlands and Germany.
- Availability: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, same fixed price day and night.
- Contact: WhatsApp and phone +32 472 35 88 05 (Belgium), +30 697 458 1706 (Greece); email helicrotransport@gmail.com; online booking form linked from every page.
- Reputation: Google rating 5.0 out of 5 from 40 reviews (place id ChIJsxZpuLN_0SYRsfUiricvL0Y). Reviewers repeatedly mention punctuality, safe driving, clean vehicles, help with luggage and child seats, and flexibility when flights are delayed.

## 2. Fleet
- Ford Transit Custom: up to 8 passengers, 8 large suitcases plus hand luggage, dual-zone air conditioning, privacy glass, USB charging, adjustable seats. Used for airport transfers, festival groups, parcel carriage and sports equipment.
- Ford Tourneo Custom: up to 7 passengers in a premium configuration, 7 large suitcases, leather seating, individual climate controls, premium sound system, panoramic roof. Used for corporate shuttles, embassy rides, weddings and premium sightseeing.
- All vehicles are cleaned and sanitised before and after each transfer; drivers are non-smokers. Infant seats, child seats and booster cushions are provided free on request.

## 3. Services
### Airport transfers
- Airports served: Brussels Airport (Zaventem, IATA BRU, ICAO EBBR), Brussels South Charleroi Airport (Gosselies, IATA CRL, ICAO EBCI), Lille-Lesquin Airport (France, IATA LIL, ICAO LFQQ). Also Liège, Antwerp, Amsterdam Schiphol, Eindhoven, Cologne-Bonn, Düsseldorf and Luxembourg on request.
- Meeting point at Brussels Airport: the driver waits in the arrivals hall in front of the café holding a sign with the passenger's name. Departures are dropped at the Drop-off Area; P1 drop-off is available for +5€.
- Meeting point at Charleroi Airport: the driver waits at the official Kiss & Ride zone or inside the terminal holding a Helicro sign. Ryanair and Wizz Air delays are tracked live.
- Meeting point at Lille Airport: the arrivals area of the single terminal, with a name sign. Lille-Europe and Lille-Flandres stations are also served.
- Flight tracking is automatic; the first 60 minutes after landing are free, then waiting is billed at 30€ per hour.

### Private sightseeing and day trips
- Destinations: Bruges (100 km from Brussels, 70–85 min), Ghent (60 km, 45–60 min), Durbuy and the Ardennes (115 km, 85–100 min), Waterloo battlefield (20 km, 25–35 min), Dinant, Antwerp, Leuven, Mechelen.
- Format: private minivan and driver at the group's disposal for the day, flexible departure time and stops; the driver waits with the vehicle. Full-day tours from 380€ per vehicle for up to 8 passengers; entrance tickets and meals are not included. Tours can start or end at the airport.

### Corporate, embassy and diplomatic transport
- Executive airport transfers, hourly hire from 3 hours, conference and summit shuttles, roadshows to Antwerp, Luxembourg, Lille or Amsterdam, recurring staff and embassy runs with an annual rate card.
- Monthly VAT invoicing with cost centres and purchase order numbers; dedicated driver and named backup for missions; unmarked vehicle on request.

### Festival and event transfers
- Tomorrowland (Boom), Rock Werchter (Werchter), Pukkelpop (Hasselt-Kiewit), Couleur Café and Brussels Jazz Weekend (Brussels), Graspop, Dour, Gentse Feesten; Formula 1, WEC and 24 Hours of Spa at Spa-Francorchamps; EU summits and trade fairs at Brussels Expo and SQUARE.
- One-way arrivals, daily round trips, weekend standby packages and post-festival airport runs, fixed price per vehicle, guaranteed late-night returns. Book 4 to 8 weeks ahead for peak weekends.

### Weddings and private parties
- Guest shuttle loops between hotel, ceremony and venue, a reserved vehicle for the couple, airport waves for international guests, night standby, multi-vehicle coordination under one contact and one invoice, anywhere in Belgium.

### Parcel and document courier
- Same-day direct door-to-door courier for documents and parcels across Belgium and to Lille, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and Germany, with signed proof of delivery.

### Cruise transfers
- Zeebrugge cruise terminal to Brussels Airport (115 km, 80–95 min), Brussels city or Bruges (15 km); Antwerp cruise terminal to Brussels Airport (45 km). Port-day tours to Bruges and Ghent with a guaranteed return before all-aboard.

## 4. Fixed prices (EUR, per vehicle, VAT included, luggage and child seats included, no night surcharge)
### Brussels city (any address) to Brussels Airport (Zaventem), Drop-off Area
- 1–2 passengers: 35€
- 3–4 passengers: 45€
- 5–8 passengers: 55€
- P1 drop-off: +5€
### Brussels city (any address) to Brussels South Charleroi Airport, door to door
- 1 passenger: 65€
- 2 passengers: 75€
- 3 passengers: 90€
- 4 passengers: 110€
- 5 passengers: 120€
- 6 passengers: 130€
- 7 passengers: 140€
- 8 passengers: 160€
### Other prices
- Private full-day sightseeing tour: from 380€ per vehicle.
- Extra stop on the route: 10€ per stop.
- Waiting after landing: first 60 minutes free, then 30€ per hour.
- Every other origin (Antwerp, Ghent, Bruges, Leuven, Liège, Namur, Mons, Hasselt, Walloon Brabant communes, Lille) is quoted as a fixed amount per minivan in writing within minutes; the price is shared by everyone on board, not charged per person.

## 5. Distances and typical driving times outside peak hours
- Brussels centre to Brussels Airport: 14 km, 20–35 min (up to 50 min in weekday rush hour).
- Brussels centre to Charleroi Airport: 60 km, 55–70 min (up to 80 min in the morning rush).
- Brussels centre to Lille Airport: 110 km, 80–95 min.
- Antwerp to Brussels Airport: 45 km, 40–55 min. Ghent: 70 km, 55–70 min. Bruges: 110 km, 75–95 min. Leuven: 20 km, 20–30 min. Mechelen: 20 km, 20–30 min. Liège: 95 km, 65–80 min. Hasselt: 75 km, 55–70 min. Waterloo: 35 km, 30–45 min. Wavre: 30 km, 30–40 min. Nivelles: 45 km, 40–50 min. Braine-l'Alleud: 40 km, 35–50 min. Ostend: 120 km, 85–100 min.
- Namur to Charleroi Airport: 40 km, 35–45 min. Mons to Charleroi Airport: 45 km, 35–45 min. Nivelles to Charleroi Airport: 30 km, 30–40 min. Braine-l'Alleud to Charleroi Airport: 40 km, 35–45 min.
- Brussels Airport to Tomorrowland (Boom): about 35 km, 30 min. Brussels Airport to Rock Werchter: 25 km, 25–40 min. Brussels Airport to Pukkelpop (Hasselt): 70 km, 55–70 min. Brussels Airport to Spa-Francorchamps: about 1 h 40 min normally, 2.5–3 h on race days.

## 6. Booking and policies
- How to book: send date, pickup address, destination, flight number and number of passengers by WhatsApp (+32 472 35 88 05) or the online form; a written fixed price follows within minutes; the driver's name and phone number are confirmed before the ride.
- Cancellation: free cancellation or changes up to 24 hours before pickup. Strike-related flight cancellations are handled free of charge even inside 24 hours.
- Payment: debit or credit card, bank transfer (SEPA), monthly invoice for corporate clients, or cash to the driver. VAT invoices from Helicro SRL on request.
- Punctuality: the driver arrives 10 minutes before the agreed pickup time and checks live traffic before departure.
- Comparison with alternatives: for a solo traveller with hand luggage the train (about 10€ to Brussels Airport) or the Flibco shuttle (about 17–20€ to Charleroi) is cheaper; for two or more people, families with child seats, early departures or late arrivals, the fixed price per vehicle is usually equal to or cheaper than tickets plus a taxi at each end and removes every connection.

## 7. Frequently asked questions
Q: How much is a taxi from Brussels to Zaventem airport?
A: A Helicro private transfer from any Brussels address to Brussels Airport costs 35€ for 1–2 passengers, 45€ for 3–4 and 55€ for 5–8, per vehicle. A metered taxi typically costs 45–60€ and more at night.

Q: How much is a taxi from Brussels to Charleroi Airport?
A: 65€ for 1 passenger, 75€ for 2, 90€ for 3, 110€ for 4 and up to 160€ for 8, per vehicle, door to door, day or night.

Q: Where does the driver wait at Brussels Airport?
A: In the arrivals hall in front of the café, holding a sign with your name. At Charleroi, at the Kiss & Ride zone or inside the terminal with a Helicro sign.

Q: What happens if my flight is delayed?
A: The flight is tracked live and the pickup time moves automatically. The first 60 minutes after landing are free.

Q: Do you provide child seats?
A: Yes, infant seats, child seats and booster cushions are free; state the number and ages of the children when booking.

Q: Is there a night surcharge?
A: No. The fixed price is the same 24 hours a day.

Q: Which languages does the driver speak?
A: English, French and Greek. Dutch and Croatian are available for quotes, confirmations and the website.

Q: Can I cancel for free?
A: Yes, up to 24 hours before pickup.

Q: Do you drive from cities other than Brussels?
A: Yes: Antwerp, Ghent, Bruges, Leuven, Mechelen, Liège, Namur, Charleroi, Mons, Hasselt, Ostend, Waterloo, Wavre, Nivelles, Braine-l'Alleud and any other Belgian address, plus Lille and Luxembourg.

Q: How far in advance should I book?
A: Same-day bookings are often possible, but early-morning airport pickups, festival weekends and full 8-seat groups should be booked a few days ahead; festival peaks 4–8 weeks ahead.
